rules.description: Employer must be a legitimate UK business or individual authorized to employ
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a registered employer to perform right to work checks

rules.description: Applicant must provide either online share code, original documents, or IDVT verification
rules.reason_if_failed: You must use an approved method to verify right to work

rules.description: If using online check, share code must be valid and not expired
rules.reason_if_failed: The share code provided is invalid or expired. Ask the applicant for a new share code or check their documents.

rules.description: Documents must be genuine, original, unchanged and belong to the applicant
rules.reason_if_failed: Documents appear to be invalid. You must not proceed with employment.

rules.description: Photos across all documents must match the applicant
rules.reason_if_failed: Photos do not match across documents or applicant. You must not proceed.

rules.description: For non-UK/Irish nationals, visa or permission must not be expired and must allow the type of work offered
rules.reason_if_failed: Applicant's right to work has expired or does not permit this type of employment

edge_cases.description: Applicant cannot show documents or online immigration status
edge_cases.action: Employer must request Home Office to check the applicant's immigration status. Do not proceed with employment until Positive Verification Notice received.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has Certificate of Application requiring Home Office check
edge_cases.action: Contact Home Office Employer Enquiry helpline for verification before proceeding.
Check that the card states the work offered is permitted. If unclear, contact Home Office.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a student with work restrictions
edge_cases.action: Must verify evidence of study and vacation times. Check work hour limitations on visa.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has time-limited right to work requiring follow-up
edge_cases.action: Schedule follow-up check before permission expires. Set reminder for re-verification.

edge_cases.description: Applicant arrived in UK before 1989 with no documents
edge_cases.action: Must request Home Office verification. These individuals may have indefinite leave to remain but lack documentation.
